name: Market Identification 98
definition: Context, or geographic environment, in which trading parties may meet in order to negotiate and execute trades among themselves.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Code allocated to places of trade (stock exchanges), to regulated markets (for example, Electronic Trading Platforms - ECN), and to unregulated markets (for example, Automated Trading Systems - ATS), as sources of prices and related information, in order to facilitate automated processing.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Nature of a market in which transactions take place.

SmartContractAutomatedPricingRule.definition: When Type/Code does not equal SmartContractAutomatedPricingSystem (SCAS) then Identification/Description length must be maximum 35 characters.
